text_block_list.text:
One afternoon. At Meisho Doto's request, I 
was helping her with dance practice.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four. Hop, step, three, 
four—

She must have practiced diligently up 
until now; though her head was slightly 
downcast, her steps were precise. However—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hawaah!? Two, three, four~ One, twoo—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-When people cheer for me... I get so 
embarrassed... my legs... aahh!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: One! Three! Two! Four! Oonee!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: E... Eek, I-I can't stop~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'm so sorryyy... It went all the 
way to the corner of the room.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Why am I like this...? The moment I feel 
like I'm being watched, my body just stops 
listening to me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
What should I do... At this rate, I might 
do something weird during the actual live 
performance too...
choice_data_list: Let's practice like it's "the real deal."

Let's find a charm to keep you from 
getting nervous.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hu... Feels like the real deal? Wh-Wh-What 
is this, I've got a really bad feeling 
about this—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Waahhh! Wh-Why a sudden mini live? And a 
surprising number of people showed up too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is impossible! I'll apologize to 
the customers, so let's cancel for today—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!?!?!
(WOOAAAH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, I accidentally wandered onto the 
stage... And they're st-staring... staring 
at me, aren't they...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa, as I thought, it's 
impossibleee...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Aaaaamazing!!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What an original entrance! You're a true 
genius, Doto. Right after me, that is!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-Opera O-san... Why are you here...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... When I heard my sworn ally was 
holding a mini-live, I barged in... nay, 
came to lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, Doto, together let us create an 
unprecedented, one-and-only, 
next-generation stage!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, please wait~! This concert is just 
for practice, so... Hawawawa~!

The appearance of the special guest 
energized the concert venue even more. 
Through this special training, Meisho Doto 
seemed to have grown a little.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But, is there really such a convenient 
charm ...l-like that out there~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You bet there is~~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyawaaaaaa!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Y-Y-You startled me. Oh, it was just 
you, Fukukitaru-san~

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's me! Wherever there's 
fortune-telling, there you'll find 
Fukukitaru! Leave bringing in the 
happiness to me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Is there any salvation for me...? 
Is there a magic spell that'll let me 
dance without getting nervous~~~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do! Namely! The One-Legged 
Turf Course Hop-Around Lap ~Fall and Go 
Back to Start ☆ Endurance Race~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hopping on one foot... for a whole lap...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If that's all it takes... I'll hop on one 
foot right this second~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: —Gyaaah!

Meisho Doto took off running only to trip 
immediately. It seemed like it might at 
least serve as good core training.
